models.qualification: Exact object KGZ 8615, internal museum record MedicumUJ-139. The primary museum API embeds this exact Sketchfab UID and dates the cast plaster to the beginning of the twentieth century; the 1996 date is its donation, not manufacture. Maker and manufacture place are unrecorded. The museum lists height 70 cm and width 22 cm, with no depth. The largest 1920 px source thumbnail and the 2665×4000 official photograph were actually inspected. Both show the same complete figure, dark surface, AESCULAP inscription, sandals, serpentine staff and rectangular base. The bare adult torso and mature bearded face are clearly visible; the lower body is draped. Native crown, reverse, thin serpent and hand capture must still be reviewed.
